messages:
oliver.m: Hey team — Oliver here, starting on infra. I need help for an acceptance test workflow: (1) sink a small billing export into a BigQuery dataset billing_export_sink in project oliver-sbx, (2) have CI running on GKE write/verify one sample row, and (3) CI needs to upload a signed artifact and store its arn in AWS SSM in infra acct 321654987000. Who owns these perms and whats the minimal set I should request? cc @cloud-ops
tia: welcome! :wave: High level: GCP: create a dedicated SA in your sandbox project (eg oliver-billing-sa) and grant dataset-level roles/bigquery.dataEditor. Give you roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator on that SA so CI/GKE pods can impersonate via Workload Identity.
lucy: For GKE -> Workload Identity, create a k8s service account and bind it to the GCP SA. If CI uses GHA OIDC, include the OIDC issuer+subject in the ticket. For the BigQuery sink, prefer dataset-level permissions and not project-wide.
security: Quick security note: accessing infra account SSM or cross-account KMS requires justification. Default onboarding expiry for SSM writes is 14 days; for KMS in prod keys it's 7 days and needs manager + security approval.
finance-bot: If you need to link the project to a billing account or enable billing export, we need the billing account id and dataset name — that action requires billing-admins or a Billing Account User role. If you want us to flip the link, include billing_account_id in the ticket.
ops-oncall: region gotcha: org policy restricts some regions for billing export sinks and for AMI signing. If you prefer eu-west1 or us-central1 call it out in the ticket; infra will validate org policy before provisioning.
infra-bot: Please create a cloud-access ticket using the 'Onboarding - IAM/Permissions' template: https://redwood.atlassian.net/secure/CreateIssue!default.jspa?project=CLOUD Include: GCP project id, dataset, k8s namespace + ksa, OIDC issuer/subject (if applicable), AWS account id, SSM path, KMS resource (if needed), desired expiry, and whether project needs billing export enabled.
tia: If you want a quick pasteable snippet for the ticket for infra to pre-provision, use this: ```bash
# create SA
gcloud iam service-accounts create oliver-billing-sa --project=oliver-sbx --display-name="oliver billing sink"
# dataset-level grant
bq add-iam-policy-binding oliver-sbx:billing_export_sink --member=serviceAccount:oliver-billing-sa@oliver-sbx.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/bigquery.dataEditor
# allow you to impersonate the SA
gcloud iam service-accounts add-iam-policy-binding oliver-billing-sa@oliver-sbx.iam.gserviceaccount.com --member=user:oliver.m@redwood.com --role=roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator
```
lucy: And if your CI uses Workload Identity mapping, also include this binding when filing the ticket (paste project number and pool id): ```bash
# Workload Identity binding example
gcloud iam service-accounts add-iam-policy-binding oliver-billing-sa@oliver-sbx.iam.gserviceaccount.com \ 
  --member="principalSet://iam.googleapis.com/projects/PROJECT_NUMBER/locations/global/workloadIdentityPools/POOL_ID/attribute.repository/namespace:ci-namespace" \ 
  --role="roles/iam.workloadIdentityUser"
```
ops-oncall: For AWS SSM writes we create a cross-account assume-role in infra account scoped to the exact SSM path. Minimal SSM actions: ssm:PutParameter on arn:aws:ssm:REGION:321654987000:parameter/infra/onboard/oliver/* . If you upload artifacts to S3 before writing the SSM pointer add s3:PutObject limited to the prefix.
security: Example trust snippet you can paste for infra to create a role (they will tighten Principal to the proper federated subject): ```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{
    "Effect": "Allow",
    "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::321654987000:root"},
    "Action": "sts:AssumeRole"
  }]
}
```
oliver.m: thanks. I prefer temporary tokens for CI. Whats the typical expiry?
tia: standard onboarding window: 14 days for dataset + SSM validation. If the request touches production KMS keys youll get 7 days and need security + manager signoff. Ask for the shortest window you need and mention if you'll request an extension.
finance-bot: Also, if you need us to enable billing export to that dataset, include billing account id and desired dataset region. We will run the link and confirm org policy compliance.
oliver.m: filing CLOUD-1820 now: project=oliver-sbx, dataset=billing_export_sink, k8s ns=ci, ksa=ci-billing-ksa, OIDC issuer=https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com, OIDC subject=repo:team/repo:ref:refs/heads/validation, aws acct=321654987000, ssm=/infra/onboard/oliver/artifact, region=us-central1, expiry=14d, billing_account=000222-333444-A1B. tagging @cloud-ops for triage. Thanks everyone! :grin:
